title: Engine trust file
description: Structure only: required and forbidden members, types, enumerations, string patterns, and length and count limits. A document this schema accepts can still be refused by the engine, because the engine's relational and time-based rules cannot be expressed here; the Python validator in public_pilot is authoritative. Not expressed here: whether a key belongs to the author it names, which only a trusted channel or the catalog can establish. Authoritative: the grant checks of public_pilot.packages.verify_envelope, applied to every grant by public_pilot.catalog.validate_trust.
$comment: Patterns end in $(?!\n) so that regular-expression engines whose $ also matches before a final newline still require a whole-string match. JSON Schema counts 1.0 as an integer; the engine requires integer literals.
